vibe: Apple Arcade meets Stardew Valley meets a Pinterest cozy-home moodboard. Warm rugs, wagging hearts, soft house, warm interiors, calm lamps.

gradients.banned: AVOID purple/violet gradients. AVOID generic centered card grids.

fonts.heading: 'Fraunces', serif
fonts.banned: AVOID Inter, Roboto, and generic AI-slop fonts.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-heading tracking-tight text-primary leading-tight
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-heading tracking-tight text-primary leading-tight
hierarchy.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-heading tracking-tight text-primary leading-snug

typography.alignment: Left-aligned reading-flow app. Do NOT use centered marketing page layouts.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped UI.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Soft, rounded corners. Use rounded-3xl or rounded-[2rem] for main cards.
layout_and_spacing.grid: Asymmetric bento layouts for the hub. Avoid generic centered symmetric grids.
layout_and_spacing.visual_flourishes: Grain texture overlays, hand-drawn organic borders, soft glows around active elements, soft ambient shadows.

motion_and_interactions.general: Smooth, gentle, cozy. Use Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.hub_reveal: Staggered reveal on the Hub (children animate in sequence with a gentle slide up and fade).
motion_and_interactions.pet_card: Soft float animation on pet cards (gentle up and down motion, Y-axis).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and soft shadow expansion. Warm glow on hover.
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Ensure all animations respect prefers-reduced-motion media query or in-app settings.

components_strategy.hub: Custom HTML/Tailwind for organic, bento grid layout.
components_strategy.cards: Cardless or heavily customized Shadcn cards. Warm paper backgrounds, soft rounded corners, no harsh borders.
components_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), soft drop shadows, warm accent colors (terracotta or moss green).
components_strategy.pet_picker: Carousel of real dog photos, elegant left-aligned text, soft overlays.
components_strategy.puzzle: Calm 6x6 match-3 board with rounded earthy pieces.
components_strategy.story_mode: Left-aligned reading flow, large immersive images with soft rounded edges.

image_assets.description: Cozy living room interior (placeholder for AI generated illustration)

accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for the marketing/landing page. No Shadcn card blocks for landing.
Implement Framer Motion for staggered reveals on the Hub and soft floating animations on the pet cards.
Apply grain texture to backgrounds globally to achieve a tactile, cozy feel. Add a CSS class `.bg-grain { background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,...'); }` or similar.
Ensure all fonts are loaded from Google Fonts (Fraunces for headings, Nunito for body).
Integrate the pet_picker_dogs and pet_picker_cats images in the onboarding/pet picker carousel.
Build the 6x6 match-3 puzzle with calm, earthy colors for the tiles (terracotta, moss green, ochre, sky blue).
DO NOT use generic purple/violet gradients. Rely on warm organic colors.
